tasks.short: Explain cost and revenue trends and prepare financial scenarios for the three sites.

today.trigger: A forecast update, investment proposal or management question needs financial analysis.
steps: Extract actuals and outstanding commitments from AFAS and review the latest Power BI refresh.
Collect site assumptions, staffing agency costs and relevant contracts.
Build Excel projections and reconcile them to the ledger.
Discuss unusual movements with site managers and present conclusions to the Controller.
drudgery: Rebuilding joins between ledger accounts, sites and cost categories.
Copying assumptions between spreadsheets.
Tracing explanations back to contracts and transactions.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling extracts, finding commitments missing from the ledger and waiting for site assumptions.

lenses.faster: Reuse reconciled AFAS data and a standard scenario model; manual exports, repeated joins and chart rebuilding disappear. A language model drafts explanations from verified figures and linked documents.
lenses.autonomous: After a successful nightly extract, recalculate approved scenarios and flag material changes. Missing commitments or stale assumptions stop the draft from being marked ready.
lenses.ambitious: Provide a weekly view of cost pressure and financial exposure for Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Add operational unit economics once reliable shipment, warehouse volume and capacity data become available.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and source hunting. Keep the discussions that explain why margins changed and what the business can do.
lenses.options: Compare base, peak-season, lower-volume, higher-agency-rate and delayed-customer-payment scenarios using explicit assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Own the financial drivers, reconciliation checks and forecast error review instead of rebuilding each analysis.
reach: Prepare reconciled actuals and commitment bridges for FP&A.
Support the Controller with site profitability investigations.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant challenges assumptions, distinguishes timing effects from lasting changes and judges whether an operational explanation is credible.
tasks.pattern_why: Several sources must be reconciled before interpretation. Deterministic calculations produce the numbers; an llm_step drafts commentary, and a person approves assumptions and advice.

in_practice.trigger: A validated nightly AFAS extract arrives or an authorised manager requests a scenario.
steps: Check refresh timestamps, ledger totals and site mappings; stop on reconciliation failures.
Combine actuals with approved commitments, agency costs and versioned assumptions.
Calculate scenarios and compare earlier forecasts with actual outcomes using deterministic code.
Draft a source-linked explanation that separates measured movements from proposed causes.
Route the pack to the accountant and Controller, then save the approved version.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves explanations and assumptions; the Controller or FP&A owner approves any forecast incorporated into the official outlook.
data_needed: Ledger actuals by period, site and account.
Open commitments, contracts and agency rate schedules.
Approved forecast assumptions and historical forecast versions.
Operational volumes and capacity measures, if available; no operational system was specified.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint analysis register containing extract timestamps, reconciliation results, scenario versions, source links and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can supply configured datasets; the required fields and permissions still need checking.
Power BI supports scheduled refresh and refresh history, which can underpin freshness checks.
The proposed workflow and its 60% labour saving and 2.0 times elapsed speed are untested estimates for Noordhaven.

risks: Nightly data can omit current-day changes; every pack needs an explicit data cutoff.
Unrecorded commitments or missing operational volumes can make a precise-looking projection unreliable.
Generated commentary can mistake correlation for cause; explanations require source evidence.
Work overlaps with FP&A and budget reporting; reuse one model and avoid counting the same saving twice.
research_questions: Can AFAS actuals and commitments be reconciled by site without manual adjustments?
Which operational drivers exist outside the named systems, and who owns their quality?
Does a replay of previous forecasts improve accuracy against the current method?
How much of today's 40.7 hours is assembly that existing Power BI reports have not already removed?

tasks.short: Find control failures, duplicate costs and suspicious transactions, then investigate the evidence.

today.trigger: A periodic control review, unusual transaction or audit request calls for investigation.
steps: Collect AFAS transactions, supplier records, bank statements and agency invoices.
Run spreadsheet checks for duplicates, unusual postings and approval gaps.
Inspect supporting documents and discuss exceptions with process owners.
Record findings, financial exposure and corrective actions.
drudgery: Repeating the same checks on separate extracts.
Matching invoices, hours and payments across different formats.
Assembling an evidence trail for every exception.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining complete populations and separating legitimate exceptions from genuine control failures.

lenses.faster: Run repeatable tests across the complete available transaction population and attach source records automatically. The accountant starts with a prioritised exception queue.
lenses.autonomous: After each validated extract, screen for duplicate invoices, changed supplier bank details and policy exceptions. Only investigation cases are created automatically; findings need approval.
lenses.ambitious: Move from occasional samples to continuous checks across all three sites and agencies. Measure repeat failures, confirmed financial exposure and time to remediation.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive matching and evidence copying. Keep investigative work and conversations that fix weak processes.
lenses.options: Offer several test thresholds with their alert volumes and known misses. For each exception, show plausible benign explanations alongside evidence requiring investigation.
lenses.altitude: Design and improve the control library, including test coverage, false positives and escalation rules.
reach: Help the Bookkeepers prevent recurring invoice and master-data errors.
Maintain a control-remediation register for the Controller.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant judges intent, materiality and evidence quality, handles sensitive conversations and protects people from unsupported allegations.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic tests identify checkable exceptions, while document extraction can use an llm_step. Investigation, allegations and remediation require accountable human judgment.

in_practice.trigger: A successful nightly extract or a new agency invoice batch becomes available.
steps: Reconcile population totals and retain dated copies of relevant records.
Run approved duplicate, approval, bank-change and hours-to-invoice checks.
Extract relevant document fields with source references and validate totals.
Create cases showing the rule triggered, evidence, possible explanations and estimated exposure.
Have the accountant resolve or escalate cases and record corrective actions.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant confirms findings; the Controller approves material escalation. Payment holds, employee action and external reports follow existing authorisation procedures.
systems: Proposed rules service and document extraction step
data_needed: Invoices, credit notes, postings and payments with stable identifiers.
Supplier master changes and approval histories, if accessible.
Agency orders, approved hours, rate cards and invoices.
Current purchasing policies, approval limits and known legitimate exceptions.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint control register with source snapshots, rule versions, case decisions, reviewers and remediation evidence.

evidence.claim: Power Query can join tables on matching columns, supporting repeatable invoice, hours and payment comparisons.
Employee-monitoring uses of AI can raise OR consultation or consent issues; applicable rights depend on the proposed decision.
The proposed control coverage and its 45% labour saving and 1.5 times elapsed speed require a pilot.

risks: Unusual transactions are indicators, not proof of fraud.
Missing approval histories or agency exports can create gaps in coverage.
Employee-level investigations need a defined AVG/GDPR purpose, restricted access and proportionate retention.
If the design introduces employee monitoring or worker evaluation, assess OR rights and EU AI Act classification before extending its use.
Monitoring and posting or payment authority must remain separated.
research_questions: Are supplier change histories, approvals and agency hours available with stable identifiers?
Which proposed tests detect known historical errors, and how many legitimate transactions do they flag?
Can the team investigate the expected alert volume without delaying the close?
Does the intended use remain financial control, or introduce employee monitoring requiring a separate assessment?

tasks.short: Maintain budget schedules and explain actual-versus-budget differences for each site.

today.trigger: The budget cycle starts or actuals become available for a reporting period.
steps: Collect approved budget versions and AFAS actuals.
Map accounts and cost centres into the reporting structure.
Calculate variances and request explanations from budget owners.
Prepare the comparison report and agree any proposed budget changes.
drudgery: Copying actuals into budget workbooks.
Repairing mappings and spreadsheet formulas.
Chasing missing commentary and identifying the approved version.
today.time_sinks: Version confusion, changed cost-centre mappings and late explanations from budget owners.

lenses.faster: Refresh actuals against one approved budget and calculate variances automatically. Repeated copy-and-paste work and manual report formatting disappear.
lenses.autonomous: After reconciliation, publish the standard comparison within approved access controls and queue material or unexplained differences. Missing mappings prevent publication.
lenses.ambitious: Give every site a consistent weekly spending view alongside the formal monthly report. Add forecast-versus-actual tracking without silently replacing the approved budget.
lenses.joy: Remove workbook repair and routine chasing. Keep discussions about controllable spending and useful corrective action.
lenses.options: Show the effect of alternative volume, agency-rate and overtime assumptions while preserving the original approved budget.
lenses.altitude: Own the budget structure, variance thresholds and reporting rules rather than assemble each report.
reach: Provide FP&A with reliable actuals and variance bridges.
Help site managers maintain consistent cost-centre ownership.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant distinguishes accounting timing from operational overspend and challenges explanations before management acts.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved budgets, mappings and actuals support reproducible calculations and checkable reports. An optional llm_step drafts commentary, but calculations and publication eligibility use explicit rules.

in_practice.trigger: The reconciled nightly AFAS extract is ready, or an approved budget version is released.
steps: Load actuals and the locked approved budget; check totals, periods and mappings.
Calculate variances by site, account and cost owner with deterministic formulas.
Publish the standard report only when validation passes.
Queue material differences and collect explanations through a controlled review list.
Have the accountant review exceptions and retain approved commentary and budget changes.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine validated comparisons publish under approved rules. The accountant approves material commentary; the Controller and budget owners approve budget changes.
data_needed: Approved budget versions with dates and owners.
Actuals reconciled to the ledger.
Account and cost-centre mappings with effective dates.
Materiality thresholds and budget-owner explanations.
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint budget register with input versions, reconciliation results, publication status, exceptions and approved amendments.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh; this enables recurring reporting once the budget model and checks are configured.
Power Query supports joins between actuals, budgets and mapping tables.
The 70% labour saving and 2.5 times elapsed speed assume substantial manual reporting remains; neither is measured.

risks: Incorrect mappings can produce a report that reconciles overall but misstates individual sites.
Automatic publication can spread incomplete period figures unless close status and cutoff are visible.
Plausible generated explanations can conceal missing evidence.
Existing Power BI automation may already capture much of the proposed saving.
research_questions: How much reporting work remains after the existing Power BI dashboards refresh?
Is there one approved budget version with effective-dated account and site mappings?
Can the proposed process reproduce a previous report without manual corrections?
Which variance thresholds produce a manageable queue and useful explanations?

tasks.short: Check Dutch payroll premiums, employment records and related liabilities against the ledger and applicable rules.

today.trigger: A payroll control review, annual premium notice or year-end liability assessment is due.
steps: Obtain authorised AFAS payroll, contract and personnel extracts from the Payroll Specialist.
Reconcile payroll totals, declarations and payments to the ledger.
Check premium treatment, CAO provisions and relevant insurance or absence liabilities.
Discuss exceptions with Payroll and HR and document proposed corrections.
drudgery: Rebuilding payroll-to-ledger reconciliations.
Comparing contract attributes with premium settings.
Finding the applicable notice, CAO version or supporting record.
today.time_sinks: Separating genuine exceptions from effective-date differences and obtaining restricted evidence.

lenses.faster: Automate reconciliations and approved contract-to-premium checks. Present exceptions with the relevant rule version and source record.
lenses.autonomous: Run checks after each finalised payroll and when premium notices change. Produce a review pack without changing payroll or submitting declarations.
lenses.ambitious: Check the full authorised payroll population each run and track recurring causes of audit adjustments. Maintain a separate reconciliation for agency charges rather than treating agency workers as Noordhaven employees.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive comparisons and document hunting. Keep difficult interpretation and resolution with Payroll and HR.
lenses.options: Calculate bounded liability scenarios for disputed classifications or sickness-related costs, showing assumptions and missing evidence.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a tested payroll assurance framework with effective-dated rules and clear ownership of corrections.
reach: Support the Payroll Specialist with independent reconciliation and exception analysis.
Support the Controller with payroll-related accrual evidence.

tasks.human_edge: Payroll and accounting specialists interpret Dutch rules and CAO coverage, assess liabilities and take responsibility for corrections.
tasks.pattern_why: Reconciliations and approved premium checks are deterministic, but legal interpretation, sensitive records and liability judgments require specialist review.

in_practice.trigger: Payroll is finalised or a new premium notice or applicable rule version is approved.
steps: Read a restricted payroll extract and reconcile payroll, ledger, declarations and payments.
Apply approved effective-dated checks for AWf treatment, Whk settings and relevant CAO payroll components.
Separate direct employees from agency workers and test agency costs through the supplier process.
Prepare exceptions and financial liability calculations using only necessary employment and absence data.
Obtain Payroll and accountant approval, then track authorised corrections through to reconciliation.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist validates payroll treatment; the accountant approves accounting conclusions. Tax, legal or insurance specialists resolve disputed interpretations before changes or filings.
systems: AFAS Profit restricted payroll and financial extracts
data_needed: Payroll components, contract attributes and effective dates.
Payroll declarations, payment totals and ledger mappings.
Employer premium notices, insurance terms and applicable CAO versions.
Necessary absence dates and authorised financial estimates, excluding diagnoses and medical case notes.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint payroll assurance register containing minimal identifiers, rule versions, reconciliation evidence, approvals and correction references.

evidence.claim: Dutch AWf premium treatment depends on employment-contract conditions; this needs Dutch rules rather than a US unemployment-insurance template.
Dutch employee-insurance contributions include Whk; employer-specific settings require the applicable notices and circumstances.
Employers face restrictions on processing sick employees' health information.
The 45% labour saving and 1.5 times elapsed speed are untested workflow estimates.

risks: US workers' compensation terminology does not map directly onto Dutch sickness pay, WIA/Whk, insurance and employer-liability arrangements.
CAO applicability and effective dates must be verified separately for transport and warehouse populations.
Wet verbetering poortwachter issues can affect financial exposure; HR and specialists must assess the underlying obligations.
Payroll and absence data require strict AVG/GDPR access and minimisation; medical interpretation stays outside this workflow.
A correct calculation against an outdated rule still produces a wrong conclusion.
research_questions: Can Payroll provide complete effective-dated contract and premium fields without unnecessary personal data?
Which CAO provisions, employer premium notices and insurance arrangements apply to each population?
Do the proposed checks reproduce previously confirmed payroll exceptions without excessive false positives?
Who approves sickness-related liability assumptions and any Poortwachter-related exposure?

tasks.short: Advise HR and Finance on employment costs, benefits and the financial design of processes and systems.

today.trigger: HR or Finance requests advice on a benefit, compensation change or accounting-system proposal.
steps: Clarify the decision, affected employees and financial constraints.
Collect relevant costs, policies, CAO provisions and system requirements.
Calculate options and consult Payroll, HR or external specialists.
Explain the trade-offs and document a recommendation for the decision owner.
drudgery: Locating the current policy and supporting calculations.
Rebuilding similar cost comparisons.
Converting specialist comments into a coherent decision note.
today.time_sinks: Clarifying ambiguous requests and resolving assumptions across HR, Payroll and Finance.

lenses.faster: Prepare a cited briefing and reusable cost model before the first discussion. Drafting and policy searching shrink while the accountant leads the advice.
lenses.autonomous: An approved request form can start document retrieval, calculations and a draft decision note. Advice is released only after review.
lenses.ambitious: Make financial appraisal standard before benefits or process changes are approved, including ongoing administration cost and control implications.
lenses.joy: Remove policy hunting and document assembly. Keep problem framing, conversations and practical recommendations.
lenses.options: Compare several benefit or process designs on employer cost, employee impact, implementation effort and uncertainty.
lenses.altitude: Create an advice framework that makes assumptions, evidence and approval responsibilities consistent across requests.
reach: Support Compensation and Benefits with financial modelling.
Help the HRIS Analyst define accounting requirements and reconciliation controls.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant understands the decision maker's real concern, explains uncertainty and balances cost with employee trust and operational feasibility.
tasks.pattern_why: The value lies in framing and explaining a decision with people. AI can retrieve, draft and compare, but the accountant remains responsible for the recommendation.

in_practice.trigger: HR or Finance submits an advisory request with a named decision owner.
steps: Have the accountant confirm scope, affected groups and required specialist input.
Retrieve current approved policies and CAO references with version dates.
Run deterministic cost comparisons using approved aggregate assumptions.
Draft options, uncertainties and questions for Payroll, HR or external advisers.
Have the accountant lead the discussion and finalise the recommendation.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves the advice; Payroll and relevant specialists validate their domains. HR and management own employment decisions and any required OR process.
data_needed: A clear decision brief and approval owner.
Current policies, benefit arrangements and applicable CAO provisions.
Aggregate workforce and employer-cost assumptions.
Implementation constraints, specialist opinions and approved tax interpretations.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint advice register with the brief, sources, calculation versions, specialist reviews and final decision.

evidence.claim: Source-based briefing drafts and structured option comparisons are plausible language-model uses, but specialist accuracy needs checking.
AI-related organisational or personnel decisions can involve OR advice or consent rights, depending on their substance.
The proposed advisory workflow, 35% labour saving and 1.3 times elapsed speed are untested.

risks: The O*NET statement includes external-client and estate-planning work that is outside this internal logistics role.
Generated advice can cite outdated policies or overlook tax and CAO exceptions.
Individual compensation details can be exposed unnecessarily; use aggregate or synthetic inputs where possible.

If a proposed system evaluates workers or allocates work using individual characteristics, obtain an EU AI Act assessment before implementation; financial costing alone does not establish that classification.
research_questions: Which advisory requests actually reach the accountants, and which belong to HR or external advisers?
Are current CAO, benefit and policy documents controlled and searchable?
Do past cases contain reusable models, or does each request require substantial new specialist judgment?
Will decision owners accept a standard options note with explicit unresolved questions?

tasks.short: Check financial controls and reconciliations before a new system or process goes live.

today.trigger: A proposed AFAS change, agency interface or finance workflow reaches pre-implementation review.
steps: Read requirements and identify accounting, access and reconciliation risks.
Define expected outcomes and prepare test cases.
Inspect configuration and execute or observe tests in a non-production environment.
Document defects, retest fixes and give a readiness recommendation.
drudgery: Turning requirements into repetitive test cases.
Comparing expected and actual outputs manually.
Collecting screenshots, exports and retest evidence.
today.time_sinks: Unclear expected results, unavailable test environments and repeated evidence collection after changes.

lenses.faster: Draft tests from requirements and automate repeatable output comparisons. The accountant spends more time checking control design and unresolved defects.
lenses.autonomous: A new test build or configuration export reruns the approved regression suite and produces an evidence pack. Ambiguous requirements become questions rather than invented expected results.
lenses.ambitious: Test failure and recovery paths properly, including duplicate files, partial agency imports, wrong periods and failed approvals.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive checking and screenshot collection. Keep the challenge of finding where a process could fail.
lenses.options: Compare alternative control designs and rollout approaches, showing residual risks and the tests needed for each.
lenses.altitude: Own financial acceptance criteria and reusable test coverage across system changes.
reach: Support the HRIS Analyst with payroll-to-ledger interface acceptance criteria.
Help Bookkeepers validate invoice-import and approval changes.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant decides whether tests reflect real accounting risks and whether residual defects justify delaying implementation.
tasks.pattern_why: Test drafting and evidence collection span multiple tools and need review. Approved regression checks run deterministically; readiness and risk acceptance remain human decisions.

in_practice.trigger: A change enters acceptance testing or a new test configuration is available.
steps: Link requirements to financial risks and have the accountant approve expected outcomes.
Draft normal, boundary, failure and recovery cases using synthetic or appropriately masked data.
Execute approved automated checks in a separate test environment and record manual-test results.
Compare outputs, totals, permissions and duplicate-handling behaviour with approved expectations.
Assemble defects, retest evidence and a readiness recommendation for review.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant signs the financial-control assessment; system and business owners approve implementation through the existing change process.
systems: AFAS Profit test environment, if available
data_needed: Approved requirements, process maps and control objectives.
Test configuration, interface specifications and permission matrices.
Synthetic or masked test transactions with expected outputs.
Migration totals, rollback requirements and defect acceptance criteria.
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint change dossier with requirement-to-test links, configuration versions, execution results, defects, retests and sign-offs.

evidence.claim: AFAS exposes read and write connectors, providing potential integration test points; availability in a test environment must be confirmed.
Automated comparisons against independently approved expected results are an established software-testing method.
No working Noordhaven test harness is established; 40% labour saving and 1.5 times elapsed speed are pilot estimates.

risks: AI-generated expected results can repeat the implementation's mistake; accounting expectations need independent approval.
Production access or unmasked payroll data can make a test unsafe or inappropriate.
Automated tests can miss manual workarounds, access conflicts and recovery failures.
Infrequent changes may not justify a bespoke harness; reusable checks should be preferred.
research_questions: Is a separate AFAS test environment available with representative interfaces and permissions?
Which checks recur often enough to justify automation?
Would the proposed tests have caught defects found in previous implementations?
Who independently approves expected accounting outcomes and residual risks?

tasks.short: Report asset use and audit findings, and recommend practical improvements to management.

today.trigger: A management review, asset decision or completed control investigation requires a report.
steps: Collect reconciled financial data, asset records and confirmed audit findings.
Request operational evidence from site managers where available.
Calculate indicators and assess causes and possible improvements.
Prepare and present recommendations, then record agreed actions.
drudgery: Rebuilding management tables and slides.
Copying findings into reports and action lists.
Searching for the status of previous recommendations.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining credible operational utilisation measures and turning findings into agreed actions.

lenses.faster: Generate tables and a source-linked first draft from reconciled figures and confirmed findings. Reuse the action register instead of rebuilding status reports.
lenses.autonomous: After close approval or audit sign-off, assemble a draft management pack and highlight overdue actions. Recommendations remain subject to review.
lenses.ambitious: Track whether recommendations reduced idle assets, recurring errors or close delays. Compare sites only where definitions and operating conditions are comparable.
lenses.joy: Remove slide assembly and action-status copying. Keep management discussion and checking whether changes actually helped.
lenses.options: Compare repair, redeploy, lease, replace and defer options where evidence supports them, including cash effects and service constraints.
lenses.altitude: Own a reporting process that connects reliable evidence, management decisions and measured outcomes.
reach: Support the Controller with management reporting and action follow-up.
Prepare financial option comparisons for FP&A and site managers.

tasks.human_edge: The accountant explains findings fairly, challenges proposed actions and secures commitments that fit operational realities.
tasks.pattern_why: Repeatable metrics and draft preparation can be automated, but interpreting asset use and persuading managers require the accountant to lead.

in_practice.trigger: The close is approved, an audit finding is confirmed or a management review is scheduled.
steps: Load reconciled financial measures, authorised asset records and confirmed findings.
Check operational measures and flag missing or incomparable utilisation data.
Calculate approved indicators and scenario costs with deterministic formulas.
Draft a source-linked pack with proposed actions, owners and expected financial effects.
Have the accountant present the reviewed pack and record management decisions and follow-up measures.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves the report and recommendations; management authorises operational changes, spending and action ownership.
data_needed: Reconciled financial figures and confirmed audit findings.
Asset register, lease commitments and maintenance costs, from confirmed sources.
Reliable operational hours, capacity and output measures where available.
Action owners, due dates, prior decisions and outcome measures.
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint management-report register with sources, approved packs, decisions, action owners and measured outcomes.

evidence.claim: Power BI can maintain refreshed financial reporting inputs; it does not supply missing physical-utilisation data.
Drafting a management narrative from verified metrics and findings is plausible, with human validation of interpretations.
Operational data availability and management adoption are unknown; 45% labour saving and 1.4 times elapsed speed are untested.

risks: Book values, depreciation and spending do not establish physical asset utilisation.
Different site activities can make apparently comparable ratios misleading.
Recommendations can overstate savings if they ignore service capacity, lease terms or implementation costs.
Draft reports can expose sensitive findings to an overly broad audience.
Automated pack preparation does not guarantee faster management decisions or action completion.
research_questions: Where are asset registers and reliable usage measures held, and can they be linked to costs?
Which indicators are comparable across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo?
How much report preparation is manual after existing Power BI outputs are used?
Are recommendations assigned owners and evaluated against realised outcomes?

role.altitude: The accountant becomes the owner of reconciled financial evidence, repeatable assurance checks and clear decision support, helping the Controller close faster with fewer adjustments.
reach: Provide FP&A with reconciled actuals, commitments and scenario inputs.
Support Payroll with independent checks while Payroll retains payroll execution and filing ownership.
Help Bookkeepers prevent recurring invoice and master-data errors.
Work with the HRIS Analyst on interface controls and acceptance tests.
Maintain management action evidence for the Controller.
role.ceiling_note: Today's workflows are inferred from the supplied company context, not observed. The seven tasks total 217.8 hours per FTE annually, about 13.6% of the role. Assuming both accountants have that profile, the estimates release about 217 of 436 listed hours across the team, around 6.8% of their combined annual capacity and EUR 15,200 in loaded capacity value. This is a gross, unvalidated ceiling before overlap, implementation and maintenance, not a cash saving or staffing recommendation. Labour-saving percentages measure active work; speedups separately estimate elapsed task duration, including automated processing and review waits. Neither predicts the improvement in total days to close.
skills_to_grow: Build and validate reusable Power Query, SQL or coded reconciliations.
Define financial data ownership, mappings, cutoffs and source-to-report checks.
Measure forecast error, control coverage, false positives and realised action benefits.
Review generated text against sources and keep calculations deterministic.
Translate Dutch payroll and CAO requirements into specialist-approved, effective-dated checks.
Apply AVG/GDPR access controls and recognise when worker-related designs need OR and EU AI Act assessment.
Explain uncertainty and negotiate practical corrective actions with site managers.
role.ambitious_version: Run a shared financial evidence process for the three sites: reconcile each nightly extract, surface material exceptions before close, prepare traceable variance and scenario packs, and measure whether corrective actions improve forecast accuracy and reduce audit adjustments. Start with budget reporting and recurring reconciliations, measure the result, and extend only where reliable data and clear ownership support it.
